cornerCallouts: Drivers will need to be precise through Turn 1, the Nordkurve, to set up the exit and carry speed down the following straight.
It's all about carrying momentum through Turn 2, the Einfahrt Coca-Cola Kurve, a crucial corner for lap time on this short layout.
Turn 3, the Coca-Cola Kurve, is deceptively tricky. Get it wrong, and you'll pay the price with a compromised run.
The long right-hander of Turn 4, the Südkurve, puts a lot of stress on the tires. Managing them here will be key.
Turn 5, the Zielkurve, is critical for a good run onto the start/finish straight. A good exit is crucial for setting up an overtake.
Braking hard into Turn 6, the Spitzkehre, is a prime overtaking opportunity on this short circuit. Expect some daring moves here!
Turn 7, the Sachs Kurve, is a challenging chicane that requires precision and commitment. A slight mistake can cost valuable time.
It's all about nailing the exit out of Turn 8, the Parabolika, and carrying that speed onto the pit straight. This is key for setting a fast lap time.
strategyPoints: With the short layout, tire wear is less of a factor, but still crucial to manage. Teams will be watching the degradation closely.

With fewer high-speed corners, the focus shifts to mechanical grip. Teams will be tweaking their setups to maximize corner speed.
The short layout allows teams to experiment with more aggressive strategies, knowing that the fuel and tire constraints are less severe.
